verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's official docs describe a full mobile app for responding to incidents, viewing account objects, and managing settings on the go, with mobile schedules and widgets. Community users confirm they acknowledge pages from the app and that the app is the first notification channel. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that escalate and resolve actions are available in the mobile app, independent hands-on corroboration of escalating or resolving from a phone.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am

citations.quote: The PagerDuty mobile app allows you to respond to incidents, view account objects, and manage settings on the go, wherever you are.
only use the app for ack'ing the page
If you have the app it will first try to notify through the app.
